scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I'm checking on the status of my application. Can you tell me if it has been approved or denied? Also, what is my interest rate?
dialogue.agent: Your application for a home purchase loan in the amount of $35,000 was denied. The record does not include an interest rate because the loan was denied. The principal reason for the denial was a debt-to-income ratio of 50%-60%.

dialogue.user: I see. Can you explain what a debt-to-income ratio of 50%-60% means in terms of my application? Also, are there any other reasons for the denial that you can share?
dialogue.agent: A debt-to-income ratio of 50%-60% means your monthly debt payments were between 50% and 60% of your monthly income. This is the only reason for the denial that is listed in the record.

dialogue.user: I understand. Is there anything I can do to improve my chances of getting approved in the future? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include underwriting rationale, so I cannot provide specific guidance on improving your chances of approval. The loan was not sold to another institution because the loan was denied.

dialogue.user:
I see. Thank you for the information. I think that's all I need to know for now.

<Neutral> - The agent provided the information I needed, but I was hoping for more guidance on what to do next.
